name: Chinese HSK (Hanzi) HSK汉字卡组
description: HSK 3.0 characters, HSK 1-3 (1011 free sample); companion web tool provides a leveled word chart (level chips, toneless pinyin search, 100/page grid, click a cell to hear the word and jump) + word cards (hanzi read-aloud, English definition read-aloud, per-word Source attribution), 50/page. The tool adapts to whichever HSK deck it is bound to (free sample or full 11105). HSK 3.0 汉字 1-3 级（1011 个免费示例）；配套小工具提供分级词表（等级筛选 + 无声调拼音搜索 + 100/页网格，点格子读词并跳卡）与词卡（汉字点读、英文释义点读、逐词 Source 署名），50/页；工具自适应绑定的卡组（免费示例或全量 11105）。
author: Alfred Long
source: HSK 3.0 official character/vocabulary lists (public exam specification); English definitions: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0)
attribution: English definitions from CC-CEDICT (https://cc-cedict.org), CC BY-SA 4.0
